dagonic.name: Dagonic
dagonic.description:
Rivulets of Exocrine fluid, hardened over passing centuries.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions, Sagiant Entrati Casket, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.

damaged-necramech-casing.name: Damaged Necramech Casing
damaged-necramech-casing.description:
The damaged remains of a Necramech supporting frame.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift, and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

damaged-necramech-engine.name: Damaged Necramech Engine
damaged-necramech-engine.description:
An engine designed for use in a Necramech. Unfortunately, it's damaged.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

damaged-necramech-pod.name: Damaged Necramech Pod
damaged-necramech-pod.description:
A modular component for a Necramech. It's damaged and in need of repair.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

damaged-necramech-weapon-barrel.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Barrel
damaged-necramech-weapon-barrel.description:
The damaged barrel of a heavy-duty Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

damaged-necramech-weapon-pod.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Pod
damaged-necramech-weapon-pod.description:
A broken weapon system intended for a Necramech.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

damaged-necramech-weapon-receiver.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Receiver
damaged-necramech-weapon-receiver.description:
A broken frame that can be used in the construction of a Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

damaged-necramech-weapon-stock.name: Damaged Necramech Weapon Stock
damaged-necramech-weapon-stock.description:
The fractured back portion of a large Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

daughter-token.name: Daughter Token
daughter-token.description:
A token of Daughter's gratitude.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk on Deimos.

detonite-ampule.name: Detonite Ampule
detonite-ampule.description:
Researching the Detonite traces within could advance our weapon technology.

Location: Venus, Earth, Lua, Ceres, Saturn, Sedna, and the Kuva Fortress

detonite-injector.name: Detonite Injector
detonite-injector.description:
Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.

Location: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards

devar.name: Devar
devar.description:
A cloudy crystal.

Location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Blue Mining Veins and Thumpers

devolved-namalon.name: Devolved Namalon
devolved-namalon.description:
Retrieved from its Infested state, restored to worth and utility.

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.

dominus-aureus.name: Dominus Aureus
dominus-aureus.description:
Stolen golden seals emblematic of royal authority in Duviri. Return them to restore Dominus Thrax to the throne.

Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw

dracroot.name: Dracroot
dracroot.description:
Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

Location: Duviri

dusklight-sarracenia.name: Dusklight Sarracenia
dusklight-sarracenia.description:
This robust, carnivorous plant has adapted to conditions in polluted waters. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Dusklight Sarracenia plants growing in Grineer Shipyards found commonly on Ceres
